name: Phalti
overview: Phalti, also called Phaltiel, is identified in Scripture as the son-in-law of Saul and the husband given Michal, David's wife, by Saul (1 Samuel 25:44). Later, Ishbosheth, Saul's son, took Michal from Phalti (2 Samuel 3:15), and Phalti followed her weeping, illustrating the personal sorrow involved in this transfer (2 Samuel 3:16). These passages highlight Phalti's role within the complex family and political dynamics surrounding David and Saul's house.
